#!/bin/sh

out=/work/report.md
echo "# Log Report - $(date -u)" > "$out"
echo "" >> "$out"
echo "Scanned directory: /work/logs" >> "$out"
echo "" >> "$out"
echo "Files modified within last 1 day:" >> "$out"
find /work/logs -type f -mtime -1 -printf "%p %k KB %TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS\n" 2>/dev/null >> "$out" || echo "(none)" >> "$out"
echo "" >> "$out"
echo "Summary of error-like matches across recent files:" >> "$out"

  wc -l /tmp/log_matches.txt >> "$out"
  echo "" >> "$out"
  sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/log_matches.txt >> "$out"
else
  echo "No error-like lines found in files modified within last 1 day." >> "$out"
fi

echo "" >> "$out"
echo "Per-file details (last 200 lines and matched lines):" >> "$out"
find /work/logs -type f -mtime -1 -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  echo "## File: $f" >> "$out"
  stat -c 'Size: %s bytes, Modified: %y' "$f" >> "$out"
  echo "### Last 200 lines" >> "$out"
  tail -n 200 "$f" >> "$out"
